# Popover: `jl-popover`

A floating panel that opens from a button: a small form, settings or details, closed by a click outside.

- Class `JlPopover`, a molecule: `import { JlPopover } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/popover

A panel of content that opens by its trigger: put a button in slot="trigger" and the content in the
default slot. A click on the trigger opens and closes it; a click outside or Escape closes it too (the browser's
popover light dismiss).

When it opens, the focus moves to the first field or button inside, or to the panel itself; Escape sends it back to
the trigger. A heading names the panel for screen readers (the trigger does otherwise). Unlike a dialog, the page
around stays usable: keep a popover for small things, a form of a few fields or a handful of details.

## Use

```ts
import { JlButton, JlInput, JlPopover } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlPopover heading="Share this file" placement="bottom-start">
  <JlButton slot="trigger" icon="share" label="Share" />
  <div class="stack">
    <JlInput label="Email" type="email" placeholder="name@example.com" />
    <JlButton variant="primary" size="sm" label="Send invite" />
  </div>
</JlPopover>
```

```html
<jl-popover heading="Share this file" placement="bottom-start">
  <jl-button slot="trigger" icon="share" label="Share"></jl-button>
  <div class="stack">
    <jl-input label="Email" type="email" placeholder="name@example.com"></jl-input>
    <jl-button variant="primary" size="sm" label="Send invite"></jl-button>
  </div>
</jl-popover>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `open` (attribute `open`): `boolean`, default `false`. The panel shows.
- `heading` (attribute `heading`): `string`, default `''`. A title over the content; it also names the panel for screen readers.
- `placement` (attribute `placement`): `Placement`, default `'bottom-start'`. The side of the trigger the panel goes on, and where along it.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `open` (`onOpen` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The panel opened.
- `close` (`onClose` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The panel closed: the trigger, a click outside, Escape or hide().

## Slots

- `trigger`: The button that opens and closes the panel.
- The default slot: The panel’s content.

## Methods

- `show(): void`: Opens the panel.
- `hide(): void`: Closes the panel.
- `toggle(): void`: Opens the panel when it is closed, and closes it when it is open.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The floating panel.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Details on demand

```html
<jl-popover heading="Shipping">
  <jl-button slot="trigger" icon="info" label="Delivery times"></jl-button>
  <p class="muted">Orders placed before 2 pm ship the same day. Delivery takes one to three working days in Switzerland.</p>
</jl-popover>
```

### A settings form

A small settings form: the focus moves to the first field, Save closes the panel.

```html
<jl-popover class="demo-settings" heading="Display">
  <jl-button slot="trigger" icon="settings" label="Display settings"></jl-button>
  <div class="stack">
    <jl-segmented block label="Density" value="comfortable" options='[{"value":"compact","label":"Compact"},{"value":"comfortable","label":"Comfortable"}]'></jl-segmented>
    <jl-input label="Rows per page" type="number" value="25" min="10" max="100"></jl-input>
    <div class="row">
      <jl-button class="demo-save" variant="primary" size="sm" label="Save"></jl-button>
    </div>
  </div>
</jl-popover>
```

```js
const popover = root.querySelector('jl-popover');
root.querySelector('.demo-save').events.register('press', () => popover.hide());
```

### Placements

placement picks the side; the panel flips when there is no room.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-popover placement="bottom-end">
    <jl-button slot="trigger" label="Bottom end"></jl-button>
    <p class="muted">Aligned with the trigger's end edge.</p>
  </jl-popover>
  <jl-popover placement="right">
    <jl-button slot="trigger" label="Right"></jl-button>
    <p class="muted">Beside the trigger.</p>
  </jl-popover>
  <jl-popover placement="top">
    <jl-button slot="trigger" label="Top"></jl-button>
    <p class="muted">Over the trigger.</p>
  </jl-popover>
</div>
```
